cover.title: 封面 Cover
cover.prompt: Use the uploaded baby photo as the only identity reference. Create a square 1:1 cover for a bilingual 0-3 year old 日常行为认知书 picture book. The exact main title must be: My First Daily Routines 我的第一本日常行为认知书. Use a clean, bright, warm and soothing premium parenting-magazine editorial layout. Show the same baby in a realistic professional baby portrait with natural skin texture, soft daylight, white minimal studio background, shallow depth of field. Surround the baby with bilingual labels, small numbered markers and simple theme icons. Include only elegant, readable Chinese and English typography. No extra people, no collage panels, no watermark, no border. High-detail realistic baby photography.
